name: Pan-Fried Zucchini Egg Nests with Veggie Sausage & Tomato
instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add sausages and cook until warmed through, about 5 minutes (or cook sausages according to package instructions). Remove to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and trim zucchini; use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles.
Preheat two skillets (the reserved skillet plus an additional skillet of similar size) over medium-high heat.

Once the skillets are hot, place 2 teaspoons oil in each, and swirl to coat the bottoms. Divide zucchini noodles and spices between the skillets; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, about 2 minutes.

When the zucchini noodles are soft, reduce heat to medium-low. Using a spatula, divide and shape noodles into 8 flattened mounds (4 mounds per skillet), making an indent at the center of each to create a "nest."
Gently crack an egg into each "nest." Cover each skillet with a lid and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, 3-4 minutes; remove from heat.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and halve tomatoes.
To serve, divide zucchini egg nests, sausage, and tomatoes between plates; season eggs with salt and pepper. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
